quests.title: 1 - Reach the treatment room
quests.description: The treatment room is located beyond the security gate, here will take place all major radiotherapy operations

quests.title: 2 - Dosimetric instruments 1/2
quests.description: Place the calibration phantom (the cube on the cart) in the center of red cross on the bed.

quests.title: 3 - Dosimetric instruments 2/2
quests.description: Now connect the instrument cable to the Phantom.

quests.title: 4 - Test
quests.description: Go to the control room and operate the radiotherapy machine

quests.title: 7 - Test
quests.description: Go to the control room and operate the radiotherapy machine

quests.title: 9 - Bring the Phantom back in its place (1/2)
quests.description: You need to take the phantom out of the treatment room because when it's not in use, it should be stored away from radiation. Put the Phantom on the cart

quests.title: 10 - Bring the Phantom back in its place (2/2)
quests.description: Now, move the cart to the control room

quests.title: 12 - Positioning
quests.description: Move the bed until the patient is correctly positioned, use the touch screen next to the bed

quests.title: 13 - Put the mask
quests.description: Take the immobilization mask from the locker and place it on the patient's face.

quests.title: 14 - Test
quests.description: Go to the control room and operate the radiotherapy machine
